```{r}
df_subset<- read.csv("clean_data_05.csv")
```


```{r}
# Set the percentage of observations to keep
sample_percent <- 10

# Subset the data to a random sample
df_sample <- df_subset %>%
  sample_n(size = nrow(df_subset) * (sample_percent / 100))
```

```{r}
# Convert the Date column to a date object
df_sample$Date <- as.Date(df_sample$Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")
```

```{r}
# Convert the 'Date' column to a date object
df_sample$Date <- as.Date(df_sample$Date)
```


```{r}
colnames(df_sample)
```
```{r}
df_sample2 <- df_sample
```

```{r}
df_sample <- df_sample[!(df_sample$PackageFocus %in% c("History", "Standard Service", "Shop")), ]

```

```{r}
# create a new column to identify first-time and returning customers
first_time <- df_sample %>%
  group_by(CustomerId) %>%
  filter(n() == 1)

returning <- df_sample %>%
  group_by(CustomerId) %>%
  filter(n() > 1)

```



```{r}
df_sample2 <- df_sample
df_sample<- df_sample2
```

```{r}
# Get the top 4 PackageFocus for each StoreName and year for first-time customers
first_time_top4 <- first_time %>%
  group_by(StoreName, year = format(Date, "%Y"), PackageFocus) %>%
  summarise(Count = n()) %>%
  top_n(4, Count) %>%
  ungroup()

returning_top4 <- returning %>%
    group_by(StoreName, year = format(Date, "%Y"), PackageFocus) %>%
  summarise(Count = n()) %>%
  top_n(4, Count) %>%
  ungroup()




```

```{r}
colnames(first_time_top4)
```
```{r}
# Create the plot
ggplot(first_time_top4, aes(x = StoreName, y = Count, fill = PackageFocus)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(~ year, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  ggtitle("Top 4 PackageFocus by StoreName and Year") +
  xlab("StoreName") +
  ylab("Count") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.5, "lines"),
        legend.position = "none") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2, title = "PackageFocus")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(fill = "PackageFocus")
```


```{r}
# Filter the data
first_time_top4_sub <- first_time_top4 %>%
  filter(year != "2023") %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  top_n(10, Count) %>%
  ungroup()

# Create the plot
ggplot(first_time_top4_sub, aes(x = StoreName, y = Count, fill = PackageFocus)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(~ year, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  ggtitle("Top 4 PackageFocus by StoreName and Year") +
  xlab("StoreName") +
  ylab("Count") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.5, "lines"),
        legend.position = "none") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2, title = "PackageFocus")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(fill = "PackageFocus") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = first_time_top4_sub$StoreName)

```
```{r}
library(plotly)

# Function to rescale y-axis range
rescale_yaxis <- function(plot, max_count) {
  plot %>% layout(
    yaxis = list(
      range = c(0, max_count * 1.2),
      title = "Count",
      tickformat = ",d"
    )
  )
}

# Plot for first_time_top4
top10_stores <- first_time_top4 %>%
  group_by(StoreName) %>%
  summarise(TotalCount = sum(Count)) %>%
  top_n(10, TotalCount) %>%
  pull(StoreName)

first_time_top10 <- first_time_top4 %>%
  filter(StoreName %in% top10_stores)

# Get top 4 PackageFocus by StoreName
top4_PackageFocus_by_StoreName <- first_time_top10 %>%
  group_by(StoreName, PackageFocus) %>%
  summarise(Count = sum(Count)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Count)) %>%
  group_by(StoreName) %>%
  top_n(4, Count) %>%
  ungroup()

# Get top 4 PackageFocus by Year
top4_PackageFocus_by_Year <- first_time_top4 %>%
  filter(year != "2023") %>%
  group_by(year, PackageFocus) %>%
  summarise(Count = sum(Count)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Count)) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  top_n(4, Count) %>%
  ungroup()

# Get top 10 most visited stores
top10_most_visited_stores <- first_time_top4 %>%
  group_by(StoreName) %>%
  summarise(Count = sum(Count)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Count)) %>%
  top_n(10, Count) %>%
  ungroup()

# Create interactive plot
p1 <- plot_ly()

# Add bar chart for top 4 PackageFocus by StoreName
p1 <- p1 %>% add_trace(
  x = ~StoreName, y = ~Count, color = ~PackageFocus,
  data = top4_PackageFocus_by_StoreName, type = "bar",
  name = "Top 4 PackageFocus by StoreName"
)

# Add scatter plot for 10 most visited stores
p1 <- p1 %>% add_trace(
  x = ~StoreName, y = ~Count, 
  data = top10_most_visited_stores, type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers", marker = list(size = 10, symbol = "star"),
  name = "Top 10 most visited stores"
)

# Add bar chart for top 4 PackageFocus by Year
p1 <- p1 %>% add_trace(
  x = ~year, y = ~Count, color = ~PackageFocus,
  data = top4_PackageFocus_by_Year, type = "bar",
  name = "Top 4 PackageFocus by Year"
)

# Customize layout and rescale y

```

# Get top 10 most visited stores

  group_by(StoreName) %>%
  summarise(Count = sum(Count)) %>%

  top_n(10, Count) %>%
  ungroup()

# Create interactive plot
p <- plot_ly()

# Add bar chart for top 4 PackageFocus by StoreName

)

```{r}


# Get the top 4 stores based on their total package sales
top4_stores <- df_sample %>%
  group_by(StoreName) %>%
  summarise(TotalPackageSales = sum(TotalPaid)) %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalPackageSales)) %>%
  top_n(4, TotalPackageSales) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(StoreName)

# Filter the top 4 stores from the previous plot
first_time_top4_sub <- first_time_top4 %>% 
  filter(StoreName %in% top4_stores$StoreName)
returning_top4_sub <- returning_top4 %>% 
  filter(StoreName %in% top4_stores$StoreName)

# Get the top PackageFocus by the top 4 StoreName
top_package_focus <- df_sample %>%
  filter(StoreName %in% top4_stores$StoreName) %>%
  group_by(StoreName, PackageFocus) %>%
  summarise(Count = sum(Quantity)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Count)) %>%
  group_by(StoreName) %>%
  top_n(1, Count) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(StoreName)

# Limit to the top 10 PackageFocus
top_package_focus <- top_package_focus %>%
  group_by(PackageFocus) %>%
  summarise(TotalCount = sum(Count)) %>%
  top_n(10, TotalCount) %>%
  right_join(top_package_focus, by = "PackageFocus")

# Plot the top 10 PackageFocus by the top 4 StoreName
ggplot(top_package_focus, aes(x = StoreName, y = Count, fill = PackageFocus)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  ggtitle("Top 4 PackageFocus by StoreName") +
  xlab("StoreName") +
  ylab("Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

```
```{r}
# Get the top 10 stores based on their total package sales for each year
top10_stores_by_year <- df_sample %>%
  group_by(year, StoreName) %>%
  summarise(TotalSales = sum(TotalPaid)) %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalSales)) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  top_n(10, TotalSales) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(year, StoreName)

# Filter data for top 10 stores by year
df_top10_by_year <- df_sample %>%
  inner_join(top10_stores_by_year, by = c("year", "StoreName")) %>%
  group_by(year, StoreName, PackageFocus) %>%
  summarise(TotalSales = sum(TotalPaid), TotalQuantity = sum(Quantity))

# Plot the top 10 StoreNames by year and PackageFocus
ggplot(df_top10_by_year, aes(x = StoreName, y = TotalSales, fill = PackageFocus)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(~ year, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
  ggtitle("Top 10 StoreNames by Year and PackageFocus") +
  xlab("StoreName") +
  ylab("TotalSales") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", n = 10)

```

  x = ~StoreName, y = ~Count, color = ~PackageFocus,
  data = top4_PackageFocus_by_StoreName, type = "bar",
  name = "Top 4 PackageFocus by StoreName",
  text = ~PackageFocus
)
p2 <- p2 %>% add_trace(
  x = ~StoreName, y = ~Count, 
  data = top10_most_visited_stores, type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers", marker = list(size = 10, symbol = "star"),
  name = "Top 10 most visited stores",
  text = ~paste(StoreName, "<br>Count: ", Count)
)
p2 <- p2 %>% add_trace(
  x = ~year, y = ~Count, color = ~PackageFocus,
  data = top4_PackageFocus_by_Year, type = "bar",
  name = "Top 4 PackageFocus by Year",
  text = ~PackageFocus
)
p2 <- p2 %>% layout(
  title = "Top 4 PackageFocus by StoreName and Year, and Top 10 most visited stores for returning customers",
  xaxis = list(title = "StoreName", tickangle = 45, dtick = 1),
  yaxis = list(title = "Count", tickformat = ",d"),
  legend = list(
    x = 0.5, y = -0.1, orientation = "h",
    traceorder = "reversed"
  ),
  hovermode = "closest"
)

# Plot the two plots side by side
subplot(p1, p2, nrows = 1, widths = c(0.5, 0.5))
